title: Standard elements are stable under base change
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a ring map of finite presentation, $R\to R'$ any ring map, and $A'=A\otimes_RR'$ (of finite presentation over $R'$). If $a\in A$ is elementary standard, resp. strictly standard, in $A$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-strictly-standard-element], then $a\otimes1$ is elementary standard, resp. strictly standard, in $A'$ over $R'$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07CC (lemma-strictly-standard-base-change, line 295), Section 07C4
